Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead said about it: Plain words: mass flow needs steep smooth walls and a large outlet from the Case Study - Limestone and Clay Storage Solution | Jenike & Johanson (E7) and the Powder Perspectives: There is a Science to Powder Handling (E8), applied to compacted density between 1.5 g/cm3 and 1.8 g/cm3 from the Robotics Minindg Competition Rules 2014 1 - [PDF Document] (E4) with peak friction 39 deg to 51 deg from the Developing a New Space Economy (2019) 5068.pdf Lightning Talk or Poster (E3), so a 20 L wedge holds about half a person's weight and we plan half-full trips with shaking to break arches, from the payload mass (E10) at 30.0 kg max and the side-view dump sketch (E13).
